brief:
Israeli airstrikes killed six Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Friday, the civil defence agency reported to Middle East Eye, contradicting claims that a ceasefire was in effect. The strikes occurred across the war-damaged territory.

The deaths mark a continuation of violence even as ceasefire negotiations have progressed in recent weeks. The civil defence agency did not provide further details on the locations of the strikes or the identities of those killed.
dek: Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza, civil defence says Israeli strikes killed six people in the Gaza Strip on Friday, the civil defence agency in the war-shattered territory told AFP, despite a ceasefire.
title: Israeli strikes kill six Palestinians in Gaza despite ceasefire
